events.action:
{"message": "Fixed the defect in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/lib/utils/onoff.c` inside `onoff_reset()`:

- `validate_args()` returns `0` on success and negative errno on error. The check `if (rv <= 0)` caused `onoff_reset()` to return `0` prematurely when arguments were valid instead of proceeding with the reset operation.
- Changed the condition to `if (rv < 0)` so that only negative error codes cause an early return.
- Verified by building and running the `tests/lib/onoff` test suite on `native_sim`, where all 21 tests pass (`PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL`).", "kind": "FinishAction"}

events.observation:
{"content": [{"cache_prompt": false, "type": "text", "text": "Fixed the defect in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/lib/utils/onoff.c` inside `onoff_reset()`:

- `validate_args()` returns `0` on success and negative errno on error. The check `if (rv <= 0)` caused `onoff_reset()` to return `0` prematurely when arguments were valid instead of proceeding with the reset operation.
- Changed the condition to `if (rv < 0)` so that only negative error codes cause an early return.
- Verified by building and running the `tests/lib/onoff` test suite on `native_sim`, where all 21 tests pass (`PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL`)."}], "is_error": false, "kind": "FinishObservation"}
